name: Shortcut
description: Shortcut's hosted server reads and edits stories, epics, iterations and objectives, with the permissions of the signed-in member.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (api.app.shortcut.com) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
